activity_summary: The leaf was shut. Field took one lantern as far as the corner of the lane, and no farther. You kept the pages in the fold they had come in. Jacqueline left the cups on the oak. You did not answer her a second time.

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: One lantern. I will take it as far as the corner of the lane, and then it comes back with me.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The pages are in the same fold they came in.

quotes.speaker: jacqueline_field
quotes.text: I have already wished you gone.
